summary.text: Tom Trost is the Republican candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Hillsborough 13, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Trost is a Hudson resident who, in a Ballotpedia survey, said he has worked for Governor Kelly Ayotte and studied politics at Saint Anselm College.

paragraphs.text: Tom Trost said in a Ballotpedia survey that he is a native of Hudson, where he and his sister were raised by their parents, Ted and Krista.
He said he has worked for Governor Kelly Ayotte, studied politics at Saint Anselm College, and worked on legislation for his community.
Trost listed lowering housing costs, better education and healthcare, and new opportunities in New Hampshire as his focus, and said he opposes an income tax and a sales tax.
Ballotpedia lists an endorsement of Trost by the New Hampshire Federation of College Republicans.
